g.text: Exact factorization: D(x) = 2(1 + x)²⁸(1 + x²)Q₄₅(x). Closest field angles: 0.41934, 0.06761, 0.05684 radians for a/d = 2, 4, 8.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53616e

g.text: Temperature: 45 Q roots computed at 40 and 65 digits; maximum normalized residual ≈ 4.6 × 10⁻⁶⁷. Orange diamonds are exact roots.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53616e

g.text: Field: exact reciprocal reduction plus rational root isolation certifies all 56 zeros on |y| = 1 at each displayed coupling. Coordinates are numerical.
